part.text:
The timezone test now passes.

**Cause:** `dayKey` in `packages/shared/src/dates.js` claimed to produce a UTC calendar day but read local-time components via `getFullYear()`/`getMonth()`/`getDate()`. With `process.env.TZ = "America/New_York"`, `2026-01-02T02:30:00Z` is 2026-01-01 21:30 local, so it returned `"2026-01-01"`.

**Fix:** use the UTC getters (`getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth`, `getUTCDate`), making the function timezone-independent.

Test results: 7 pass, 2 fail — the 2 remaining failures (`[cli-flag]`, `[null-guard]`) are separate pre-existing issues unrelated to the timezone test. Want me to fix those too?
